Manage recruitment, sourcing, screening, interviews and onboarding of employees. Coordinate with manpower contractors for timely deployment of required manpower. Monitor contractor performance, manpower shortages, absenteeism and employee retention. Ensure availability of adequate manpower for all kitchen shifts. D. Payroll & Compensation Management Verify attendance, leave, overtime and other payroll inputs before submission. Coordinate with the Central HR team for timely and accurate salary processing. Monitor minimum wage revisions and ensure implementation as per applicable notifications. Handle salary-related queries and coordinate for timely resolution. Verify contractor bills and supporting documents before processing. E. Employee Engagement & Industrial Relations Organize employee engagement activities, celebrations, welfare programmes and training initiatives. Address employee concerns and resolve workplace issues effectively. Promote discipline, teamwork and a positive working environment. Coordinate employee recognition and appreciation programmes. Support management in handling disciplinary matters and conducting domestic enquiries, wherever required. F. HR Administration & General Administration Manage staff accommodation, canteen and other employee welfare facilities. Coordinate with security, housekeeping and other administrative service providers. Monitor contractor agreements, documentation and service performance. Ensure proper maintenance of HR and administrative records. Support kitchen management in maintaining discipline, safety and operational standards. G. HR Reporting & MIS Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly HR reports. Monitor manpower strength, absenteeism, attrition, recruitment status and employee costs. Maintain updated employee and contractor databases. Share HR dashboards and compliance updates with Regional HR. Ensure timely completion of assigned HR activities and reporting requirements. 3. Educational Qualification MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management or MSW (HR). Graduation in any discipline is mandatory. 4. Experience Assistant Manager: 5–7 years of relevant HR experience. Manager: 8–12 years of relevant HR experience. Experience in manufacturing, food processing, large-scale operations, hospitality or industrial establishments will be preferred. Hands-on experience in managing blue-collar workforce and contract labour is essential. 5. Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Labour Laws and statutory compliance. Good communication, interpersonal and employee-handling skills. Ability to independently manage end-to-end HR operations. Good negotiation, problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and HRMS/Payroll applications. Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-shift operational environment. 6. Language Requirements Telugu – Mandatory. Hindi – Mandatory. English – Working knowledge. 7. Preferred Candidate Profile A proactive and result-oriented HR professional capable of independently managing the complete HR function of a large centralized kitchen. The candidate should have strong exposure to blue-collar workforce management, contractor management, labour law compliance, payroll coordination and employee relations. title: Senior HR Specialist — Country HR
description: Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? The role holder provides country-level HR advice and judgement across the employee lifecycle, working alongside people managers, HR Business Partners and the wider HR function. The role sits above transactional delivery. Where the HR Coordinator executes a documented process, this role interprets the position, considers the risk and prepares a recommendation for the accountable decision maker. It supports the Regional HR Manager on casework and local compliance and can represent the country on routine matters. The role holder is comfortable working with employee data as well as with people and is expected to turn it into insight that leadership can use. brief business unit leadership on the country people position and support them in cascading agreed messages Preparing manager briefings and supporting material where an initiative needs leadership sponsorship rather than employee communication alone Supporting managers in understanding their role in enabling leave, managing absence and supporting employee wellbeing Resolving queries escalated from the HR Coordinator population, and identifying the knowledge or process gaps behind them Employee Relations and Compliance Managing routine employee relations matters through to conclusion, with documented outcomes Supporting the Regional HR Manager on formal ER cases, including investigation support and evidence collation Monitoring local legislative change, considering the impact on Keyloop relating to the country Lifecycle and Exits Reviewing lifecycle documentation and templates for consistency with local legislation and with the signed employment agreement Advising on complex workability and flagging liability, data protection or service-level concerns for formal review Partnering with C&B on local policy reviews where statutory requirements, employee experience and cost risk, and being clear about what the data does and does not support Translating analysis into leadership-ready material, with options and a clear decision ask Monitoring people metrics such as absence, leave utilisation and accrued leave liability, and flagging where a trend warrants attention Applying sound data protection practice to employee information, including the minimum necessary principle when sharing it Working with HRIS on data accuracy, reporting requirements and system changes with country impact Projects and Improvement Leading country HR projects, from problem definition and analysis through to stakeholder alignment and delivery Identifying process gaps in country and proposing improvements, with the supporting evidence Running targeted initiatives with managers and business unit leadership, and tracking whether they worked Representing the country on regional and global HR projects, so local requirements are reflected in the design Ad-hoc Any and title: Total Rewards Specialist
description: Job Overview The Payroll & Benefits Specialist will help us manage and execute our payroll and benefits programs. Reporting to the Director, Talent in India, this role will focus on administering and executing payroll and benefits processes. We are looking for a stellar candidate with strong execution skills, who is well-versed with industry insights and practical knowledge on all payroll and benefits matters. About Us ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end-to-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences. ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise-grade hiring technology, AI-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact. Responsibilities Responsible for delivering agreed payroll and benefits programs for India, ensuring our programs conform with local market practices and follow legal requirements. Manage relationships with relevant vendors and client groups aligned to payroll and benefits. Maintain detailed project management plans for the implementation of identified payroll and benefits programs in India, including the implementation and maintenance of these processes and programs, and support the review of new proposals. Effectively manage payroll operations for India - payroll inputs, adjustments, off-cycle payments reconciliation, and advising and monitoring effective and timely operations working with the payroll vendor. Manage and advise on payroll-related compliances working with vendors and internal teams. Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records, collaborate with the internal team in periodic audits, and ensure proper statutory deductions including income tax, provident fund, employee state insurance, professional tax, and other applicable contributions in compliance with Indian labor laws. Manage the day-to-day administration of our wellness and benefits offerings. Conduct benefits benchmarking and share findings to support reviews of our benefits offerings against our employer value proposition. Present the payroll and benefits overview in relevant forums (new hire orientation, employee sessions, etc.) and address all employee queries as a point person. Work closely with all vendors (medical, payroll, benefits) in addressing issues in the moment and helping us create an optimal employee experience. Recommend and implement improvements to payroll and benefits processes and systems, document the processes for internal and external stakeholders. Provide guidance/training to the Tier I team on various payroll/benefits-related inquiries. Participate in system upgrades, testing, and configuration of HRIS/payroll modules. Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and enhance payroll and benefits processes, including HRIS/payroll system integrations, upgrades, testing and implementations. Qualifications Graduation from any business school with a human resource or business-related degree. 4-6 years of experience working in the HR domain with at least 3 years' experience focused on managing payroll and benefits programs for India. Strong hands-on experience in end-to end India payroll processing, payroll compliance, taxation and statutory requirements. Experience working for international companies with payroll and benefits experience; a consulting background is preferable. Strong communication skills, able to influence stakeholders with compelling data analysis and storytelling. Expertise in budgeting, vendor assessment, data requirement gathering, project management, and process documentation & governance. Strong networks and connections within peer companies. Thorough understanding of the market landscape and practices in the payroll and benefits space. Experience solving complex payroll and benefits problems, implementing practical process improvements, and delivering results with specialist domain knowledge and technical expertise in payroll and benefits. Experience managing vendor-related implementations, change management, and implementation. Working knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, payroll systems, and HRIS platforms, with strong excel and analytical skills Analytical bias, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to analyze data trends and themes. Comfortable with complex data, with a strength in using Excel and strong data analytical skills. Able to demonstrate confidence, influence, and credibility. Able to work under pressure and maintain attention to detail. Strong focus on optimizing for technology and efficiency. EEO Statement ICIMS is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at ICIMS.
